spec.situation_desc: transferred money to someone pretending to be from the bank
spec.vuln_cue: says they can't afford this, they've got nothing left until payday

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Priya speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, it’s Imran Haddad. I transferred money to someone who said they were from the bank. I’m really unhappy with you lot about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that’s happened, Imran. Before we discuss your account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. Can you tell me a little more about the transfer?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It was £2,400, yesterday afternoon. They told me there was fraud on my account and I had to move it to a safe account. I’ve got nothing left until payday, I can’t afford this.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry to hear that, Imran. I can understand why you’re unhappy. I’ll log this as a complaint about the transfer and how this was handled.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: What happens now? Can you get the money back?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t promise an outcome. Someone will be in touch about the complaint and the transfer investigation.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I don’t have a timescale to give you, I’m afraid. I’ll take ownership of this and send the case to our complaints team today. I’ll call you by Friday to confirm it’s been passed over and update you on where things stand.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise, I’ve logged your complaint about the £2,400 transfer, and I’ll call you by Friday with an update. The complaints team will be in touch about the investigation, though I can’t say when or what the outcome will be. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, Imran. I’m sorry you’ve had to deal with this, and I’ll follow up by Friday.
